title: Richard Sutton – Father of RL thinks LLMs are a dead end
summary: Dwarkesh Patel interviews Richard Sutton, reinforcement learning pioneer, Turing Award winner and author of The Bitter Lesson. Sutton argues LLMs are a dead end because they cannot learn on the job, and that continual learning from experience will require a new architecture.
why: HN commenters cite it as the serious skeptic's case against LLMs reaching general intelligence, usually in debates about whether scaling is enough.

quote.text: Richard Sutton takes a different view in an interview with Dwarkesh Patel[2]
